entities.text: T16@200 TOP AND BOTTOM BOTH DIRECTIONS

\LNOTES.
1- BEARING PRESSURE OF ISOLATED/COMBINED FOOTING SHOULD BE AS FOLLOWS:
*	ISOLATED/ COMBINED FOOTING SHALL NOT BE LESS THAN 180 KN/m.
*	RAFT FOUNDATION SHALL NOT BE LESS THAN 180 KN/m.
2- BOTTOM OF FOOTING (B.O.F)  IS AT (+2.35 DMD) m U.N.O.
3- FOR FOOTINGS SECTIONS, REFER TO DWG No. (S-300).
4- DEWATERING IS REQUIRED FOR WATERTANK FOUNDATION

entities.text:
\LNOTE.\PACCORDING TO THE SOIL INVESTIGATION REPORT WITH REF. PDS/27401, CLAUSE 8.1.4, THE FOLLOWING APPROACH SHOULD BE CONSIDERED TO REACH A MINIMUM SOIL BEARING CAPACITY.
PLACE ONE LAYER OF 250mm THICK EACH OF ROAD BASE MATERIAL AND COMPACT THAT LAYER WITH A HEAVY ROLLER COMPACTOR (25 TONS OR MORE) TO A MINIMUM OF 98% PROCTOR MAXIMUM DRY DENSITY UNTIL REACHING THE PROPOSED FOUNDATION LEVEL.
